subject: Aligning evaluation owners & workshop: NovaViz MAP orientation
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novaviz.io>, NovaViz Procurement <procurement@novaviz.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning evaluation owners & workshop: NovaViz MAP orientation

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking time to move this forward. To set expectations for the pilot and close timeline, we9d like to run a 60-min MAP orientation workshop next week to:

- introduce stakeholders and owners
- review the draft Mutual Action Plan (high level milestones and dependencies)
- align on the evaluation plan (metrics, owners, and scoring rubric)
- confirm procurement / SOW next steps and target close date

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed, Nov 3, 10:00–11:00
- Thu, Nov 4, 14:00–15:00

Attached: preliminary MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a one-pager for the pilot. Please share who from your side should be invited (technical, product, procurement).

Zoom: I will send the calendar hold once you confirm a slot. If procurement prefers a separate alignment call, we can loop them in afterwards.

Questions for agenda prep:
1) Who will be the evaluation owner for accuracy / correctness scoring?
2) Who owns integrations / data access?
3) Any compliance contacts we should include?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Elena Morales <elena@novaviz.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Cc: NovaViz Procurement <procurement@novaviz.io>, Dave Chen <dave.chen@novaviz.io>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation owners & workshop: NovaViz MAP orientation

Thanks Olga —

Both proposed times work for us, but let's lock on Thu, Nov 4, 14:00–15:00 PT. I'll be joined by Dave (engineering lead) and I'll ask procurement to be on the invite to confirm PO timeline. Please include our security lead (I'll confirm name tomorrow).

A couple quick notes: our internal evaluation owner will likely be Product Analytics (they maintain the scoring pipelines). Also — can you include a brief section in the agenda to agree on success criteria and acceptance thresholds? That helps speed SOW approvals.

Elena
Head of Product, NovaViz

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@novaviz.io>, NovaViz Procurement <procurement@novaviz.io>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Aligning evaluation owners & workshop: NovaViz MAP orientation

Team —

Confirmed: Thu, Nov 4, 14:00–15:00 PT (90-min buffer if needed). External attendees: Elena Morales, Dave Chen, procurement. Elena will confirm their security lead tomorrow.

Action items:
- Marissa: please lead the evaluation plan section (15–20 min) and bring the proposed scoring rubric + sample eval prompts.
- Ben: prep the success metrics slide (latency, cost per inference, pass/fail thresholds) and a short runbook for pilot cutover.
- Vivek: be ready to speak to deployment options (Dedicated vs Hosted) and any auto-scaling constraints.
- Olga: I'll circulate the calendar invite with Zoom and attach the MAP_v1.xlsx and the SOW draft for procurement visibility.

I attached a quick agenda draft (below) — please suggest edits.

Draft agenda (60 min):
1) Introductions & roles (10 min)
2) MAP walkthrough (10 min)
3) Evaluation approach & rubric (15 min)
4) Pilot success criteria & ops readiness (15 min)
5) Procurement / SOW next steps & timeline (10 min)

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (already), SOW_draft.pdf (attached for procurement to pre-read).

- Olga

[Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf; Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@novaviz.io>, NovaViz Procurement <procurement@novaviz.io>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation owners & workshop: NovaViz MAP orientation

Thanks Olga — I'll own the evaluation plan. Attaching a short evaluation checklist and proposed rubric so Elena and Dave can glance before the call.

Key points I'll cover:
- scoring dimensions: relevance, precision, hallucination rate, and latency impact
- sample thresholds for pilot acceptance (pass if overall score >= 0.8 with no critical regressions)
- evaluation cadence during pilot (daily automated checks + weekly manual spot checks)

Please confirm whether NovaViz has any pre-existing datasets they'd like us to use for scoring — Dave, can you share where the sample payloads live?

Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Eval_Checklist_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Elena Morales <elena@novaviz.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: NovaViz Procurement <procurement@novaviz.io>, Dave Chen <dave.chen@novaviz.io>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation owners & workshop: NovaViz MAP orientation

Thanks everyone 94 Thu, Nov 4, 14:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Attendees: Elena (Head of Product), Dave (Eng Lead), Aaron Park (Procurement), and I9ll confirm security lead by EOD Monday.

We reviewed the attachments; the SOW draft looks good as a starting point. Procurement will route the PO after the orientation call and we9ll request a standard DocuSign flow for signatures. Please add the DocuSign link to the SOW after the meeting.

Quick ask before the workshop: can Marissa include one slide that maps each evaluation metric to the acceptance gate in the SOW? That will make approvals smoother.

See you on Nov 4.

Best,
Elena
Head of Product, NovaViz
[Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf]
